title: DeepGOPlus: improved protein function prediction from sequence
why_relevant: Provides a strong, CAFA-aligned baseline design combining CNN motif learning with sequence similarity, useful as a no-pretrained fallback or an ensemble component.
extracted_technique: CNN over k-mer/motif patterns + similarity-based label transfer; evaluate with CAFA Fmax metrics.
query: DeepGOPlus paper sequence-based protein function prediction GO terms CNN BLAST
takeaway: DeepGOPlus shows that combining discriminative motif features with retrieval/similarity boosts CAFA Fmax and remains computationally efficient.

title: cafaeval (CAFA-evaluator) Python package
why_relevant: Enables correct offline weighted Fmax evaluation using GO OBO + IA.tsv, reducing metric mismatch during CV/holdout tuning.
extracted_technique: Compute CAFA-style F, weighted-F, and S metrics with optional IA; supports max-propagation over ontology DAG.
query: cafaeval python package CAFA information accretion
takeaway: Use `cafaeval` (or its algorithm) to select thresholds and tune models against the same weighted metrics used by CAFA-style evaluations.
